The 'Number of Persons Employed' chart shows 19% (29.5 mln) for trade, not 9% (13.4 mln).
The 'Turnover' chart shows 31% (9.8 tln) for industry, not 33% (10.6 tln).
The 'Turnover' chart shows 6% (1.9 tln) for construction, not 31% (9.8 tln).
